# voxel-bind env — pip layer lock (install AFTER the conda lock).
#   conda create -p $HOME/.conda/envs/voxel-bind --file env/voxel-bind.conda-linux-64.lock
#   ENV=$HOME/.conda/envs/voxel-bind
#   PATH="$ENV/bin:$PATH" CC="$ENV/bin/gcc" $ENV/bin/pip install -r env/voxel-bind.pip.lock.txt
#   $ENV/bin/pip install --no-deps posecheck==1.3.1     # NOT in the list below -- see why
#   $ENV/bin/pip install -e .                           # VoxBind, editable -- NOT pinned here
#
# This is the VoxBind runtime as it runs on the H200 box (python 3.12, torch 2.5.1 +
# cu124 wheels, numpy 2.4.6 from conda, rdkit 2025.3.6) PLUS everything FuncBind
# imports: lightning 2.5.5, einops, biopandas, cpdb-protein, and the eight modules
# `import funcbind.train_fb` pulls at module scope (pyrosetta is in the conda layer).
# It is NOT the paper env -- that one is voxbind.conda-lock.yml (py3.10, cu118).
#
# CC is load-bearing: cpdb-protein is source-only on PyPI (no wheel) and its
# extension must be compiled. The compiler comes from the conda lock above; this
# box has no system cc. Without CC set the install of that one package fails.
#
# posecheck 1.3.1 is installed SEPARATELY with --no-deps because it pins
# `pandas==2.0.0`, which has no cp312 wheel and fails to build from source. Its
# real runtime deps (datamol, prolif, biopython, rdkit) ARE pinned below, so the
# --no-deps install lands in a working env. Same trick `00_setup_env.sh` already
# uses for the moleval env. `hydride` is deliberately absent -- import does not
# need it; add it if you run PoseCheck protonation here.
#
# VINA IS 1.2.7 HERE AND IS IMPORT-SATISFACTION ONLY. Python 3.12 cannot have
# 1.2.2 by any route (no wheel past cp39, the sdist does not build, conda-forge
# starts at 1.2.7 for py312). Every reported docking number must come from the
# py3.8 `voxdock` env (vina 1.2.2) -- which is what VoxBind's 05_evaluate.sh and
# FuncBind's chain_dock_mcp_run.sh already call by absolute path. Do not dock here.
#
# numpy is NOT in this list on purpose: the conda layer owns it (see that header).
# lightning is PINNED to 2.5.5 to match FuncBind's own env (.repro-env); a plain
# `pip install lightning` resolves pytorch-lightning to 2.6.x.
